item.title: Restaurant Review: Sidaam, Port Moresby - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Andrew Wilkins visits the recently opened sister to Kuro Haus, flavour-filled Thai restaurant and bar Sidaam.

item.title: What does the 2026 PNG 100 CEO Survey tell us? - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: This year’s Business Advantage PNG/Westpac PNG 100 CEO Survey reveals positive business sentiment, continuing the momentum from last year.

item.title: The 2026 PNG 100 CEO Survey: the results - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Since 2012, the data collected by the PNG 100 CEO Survey has revealed trends in business confidence among business leaders. So, how confident are Papua New Guinea's leading businesses about 2026?

item.title: 'We've opened accounts in all 22 provinces': CreditBank PNG CEO on what's driving his bank's rise - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: CreditBank PNG has experienced rapid growth since receiving a Papua New Guinea banking licence in 2024. In this interview with Business Advantage PNG, its CEO Danny Robinson shares the key drivers behind this success, reveals what’s next and provides his outlook for the banking sector as a whole.

item.title: Investors stepping up to guarantee Papua New Guinea's fuel security - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: PNG’s recent challenges with fuel supply are leading to the creation of a more robust supply chain, thanks to new investments and partnerships involving state-owned entities, the private sector and even the US government. Business Advantage PNG takes a closer look.

item.title: Papua New Guinea: its system of government - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: A brief guide to Papua New Guinea's political system, including tiers of government and the judiciary.

item.title: Papua New Guinea: some key social indicators - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: A brief guide to some of Papua New Guinea's key social indicators, including literacy, education, health and women's rights.

item.description: A brief guide to corruption, a key issue in Papua New Guinea.

item.title: Papua New Guinea: its environment and sustainability - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: A brief guide to Papua New Guinea's environment and sustainability practices.

item.title: PNG Power: the road towards privatisation - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Business Advantage PNG talks to the senior executives responsible for stabilising, turning around and preparing the ground for the potential sale of the country’s troubled state power utility.

item.title: People Moves: NICTA, BSP, Papua New Guinea Banking Association, Kina Securities - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: New CEO for NICTA, multiple changes at BSP, appointments at PNG Banking Association, new Deputy Chair for Kina Securities.

item.title: Four things to see and do in Lae, Papua New Guinea's second city - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Lae is the industrial and manufacturing capital of Papua New Guinea and the gateway to the densely populated Highlands region. Nadav Shemer Shlezinger shares a few top places to go for sightseeing in the coastal city.

item.title: ‘The rollout will continue’: Vodafone PNG's CEO on the telco’s ongoing expansion [video] - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Vodafone PNG has built 800 towers since becoming Papua New Guinea’s third telco in 2022. Its Regional CEO Pradeep Lal speaks with Business Advantage PNG about the progress being made in its infrastructure buildout, the impact digitalisation is having in PNG, and plans to enter the mobile money market.

item.title: On the fuel shock, Papua LNG progress and strong super fund results - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Papua New Guinea's fuel supplies and prices are under pressure, more positive signs emerge on Papua LNG, and superannuation funds deliver the goods.

item.title: Economic update: Papua New Guinea's 'year of reset' - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: With improved export receipts and the prospect of major resources projects starting in 2026, Papua New Guinea's economy is set for a sustained period of growth. Andrew Wilkins speaks with business leaders in the country about their expectations for the year ahead.
